sections.heading: Why Ethics Matters
sections.content: As AI becomes ubiquitous, we must ensure systems are fair, transparent and accountable. Ethics reduces risk and builds trust.

sections.heading: What's new in 2026
sections.content: 2026 sharpened two fronts. Agentic risk: as models act autonomously (running tools, code, even purchases), guardrails, human-in-the-loop approval and audit trails matter more than ever. Regulation: the EU AI Act's obligations are phasing in, pushing transparency, risk classification and documentation. The principles in this lesson (fairness, transparency, accountability, privacy) are increasingly legal requirements, not just good practice.
